grammar_title: 过去分词作状语(时间/原因/条件/让步;逻辑主语 = 主句主语,与现在分词对照)
source: 人教版2019必修二 Unit 5 Discovering Useful Structures:过去分词作状语。过去分词(done)的逻辑主语就是主句主语,二者是被动/完成关系;主动则用现在分词(doing)。句子地道,答案唯一。

points.point: 过去分词作时间/原因状语(被动·完成,逻辑主语=主句主语)
points.overview: 当被省略的状语从句主语与主句主语一致、且二者是被动或已完成关系时,把从句压缩成过去分词放句首作时间/原因状语:Moved by his words, she accepted his gift.(= Because she was moved…)

points.point: 过去分词作条件/让步状语(if / though 引导可与过去分词搭配)
points.overview: 表示条件用 Given more time, we could finish.(= If we were given…);表示让步常保留连词:Though invited, he didn't come.(= Though he was invited…)。

points.point: 分词逻辑主语 = 主句主语:被动用 done,主动用 doing
points.overview: 分词的逻辑主语必须是主句主语。主语承受动作(被动/完成)→ 过去分词 done;主语发出动作(主动/进行)→ 现在分词 doing。Used for performances, the hall is full of energy.(被动)≠ Using…(主动)。

questions.stem: "____ by his romantic words, the girl finally accepted his gift."
questions.explanation: 主句主语 the girl 是被打动的对象(被动),作原因状语 → 过去分词 Moved。

questions.stem: "____ in dark colours, the room needed some bright lights."
questions.explanation: the room 是被刷漆的(被动·已完成),作原因状语 → Painted。

questions.stem: "____ by this music, Whitacre said it was like seeing colour for the first time."
questions.explanation: 主语 Whitacre 被音乐激励(被动),作原因状语 → Inspired。

questions.stem: "____ in the USA in 1970, Whitacre began studying music in 1988."
questions.explanation: 出生用 be born,主语被'生于'某地(被动),作时间状语 → Born。

questions.stem: "____ by the audience's cheers, the young singer played even better."
questions.explanation: 主语 the singer 被掌声鼓舞(被动),作原因状语 → Encouraged。

questions.stem: "____ in a new way, the album was expected to be popular with fans."
questions.explanation: the album 是被录制的(被动·完成),作原因状语 → Recorded。

questions.stem: "____ to perform on the stage, he felt both nervous and excited."
questions.explanation: 主语 he 是被邀请的(被动),作原因状语 → Invited。

questions.stem: "____ for many years, the old piano still made a lovely sound."
questions.explanation: the piano 是被使用的(被动),作时间/原因状语 → Used。

questions.stem: "____ by his teacher from time to time, Henry slowly lost interest in singing."
questions.explanation: 主语 Henry 被老师纠正(被动),作原因状语 → Corrected。

questions.stem: "____ with team spirit, the band members always act as a whole."
questions.explanation: the members 充满团队精神(be filled with,被动),作原因状语 → Filled。

questions.stem: "____ deeply by the song 'Happy', Sarah began to listen to music every day."
questions.explanation: 主语 Sarah 被歌曲打动(被动),作原因状语 → Touched。

questions.stem: "____ from university in 1995, Whitacre soon studied at the Juilliard School."
questions.explanation: 主语与毕业是完成关系,过去分词表完成 → Graduated(此处用作时间状语,= After he graduated)。

questions.stem: "____ in reading her students' minds, the piano teacher soon noticed my problem."
questions.explanation: the teacher 富有经验(be experienced in,被动形式),作原因状语 → Experienced。

questions.stem: "____ and terrified at the same time, I could only agree to perform."
questions.explanation: 主语 I 是被惊到的(被动),作原因状语 → Surprised。

questions.stem: "____ by the disease, she thought she did not have much longer to live."
questions.explanation: 主语 she 被疾病吓到(被动),作原因状语 → Frightened。

questions.stem: "____ all over the world, the virtual choir has brought people together."
questions.explanation: the choir 被全世界看到(被动),作时间/原因状语 → Seen。

questions.stem: "____ by his fans' videos, Whitacre joined them into one performance."
questions.explanation: 主语 Whitacre 受到启发(被动),作原因状语 → Inspired。

questions.stem: "____ for a good cause, the music festival drew the whole school together."
questions.explanation: the festival 是被举办的(被动),作原因状语 → Held。

questions.stem: "____ onto the Internet, the videos were then joined into one virtual choir."
questions.explanation: 主句主语 the videos 被上传(被动)→ 过去分词 Uploaded;视频不会主动'上传',故不用 Uploading。

questions.stem: "____ by the rhythm of hip-hop, the children could not stop dancing."
questions.explanation: 主语 the children 被节奏点燃(被动),作原因状语 → Excited。

questions.stem: "____ in music since childhood, she chose to study composition at university."
questions.explanation: 主语 she 对音乐感兴趣(be interested in,被动),作原因状语 → Interested。

questions.stem: "____ more time, the band could have finished recording the whole album."
questions.explanation: 表条件 = If the band had been given…,主语被给予(被动)→ 过去分词 Given。

questions.stem: "Though ____ to the contest, the shy boy still refused to sing on stage."
questions.explanation: 让步从句保留 though,主语被邀请(被动)→ 过去分词 invited(= though he was invited)。

questions.stem: "____ properly, this old guitar could still produce a beautiful tone."
questions.explanation: 表条件 = If it were repaired…,吉他被修(被动)→ Repaired。

questions.stem: "Even though ____ by gradual blindness, Henry kept writing his music."
questions.explanation: 让步从句,主语 Henry 被失明影响(被动)→ affected(= though he was affected)。

questions.stem: "____ enough practice, even an ordinary person can play well in public."
questions.explanation: 表条件 = If one is given…,主语被给予(被动)→ Given。

questions.stem: "Though ____ in dark colours, the small studio still felt warm and friendly."
questions.explanation: 让步从句,the studio 被刷成深色(被动)→ painted。

questions.stem: "____ a little more encouragement, the unemployed singer would not have quit."
questions.explanation: 表条件 = If he had been offered…,主语被给予(被动)→ Offered。

questions.stem: "Although ____ by the media many times, the band members were never discouraged."
questions.explanation: 让步从句,主语被媒体质疑(被动)→ questioned。

questions.stem: "____ the right equipment, anyone can set up a small home studio today."
questions.explanation: 表条件 = If one is given…,主语被给予设备(被动)→ Given。

questions.stem: "Though ____ for performances, the Silver Hall is open to visitors in the day."
questions.explanation: 让步从句,the hall 被用于演出(被动)→ used。

questions.stem: "____ a fair chance, the street performer could become a real star."
questions.explanation: 表条件 = If he were allowed…,主语被给予机会(被动)→ Allowed。

questions.stem: "Even if ____ to a famous studio, she would still write her own songs."
questions.explanation: 条件/让步从句,主语被邀请(被动)→ invited。

questions.stem: "____ proper training, an ordinary student can learn to read a musical score."
questions.explanation: 表条件 = If a student is given…,主语被给予训练(被动)→ Given。

questions.stem: "Though ____ by sadness, Beethoven still completed his greatest works."
questions.explanation: 让步从句,主语的生活被悲伤所笼罩(be marked by,被动)→ marked。

questions.stem: "____ a louder microphone, the singer could have reached the back rows."
questions.explanation: 表条件 = If he had been handed…,主语被递给(被动)→ Handed。

questions.stem: "Although ____ many times by judges, the talented girl never lost heart."
questions.explanation: 让步从句,主语被评委拒绝(被动)→ refused。

questions.stem: "____ enough time on stage, the new band would surely win the audience."
questions.explanation: 表条件 = If the band were given…,主语被给予时间(被动)→ Given。

questions.stem: "Though ____ in a poor village, the young composer dreamed of great music."
questions.explanation: 让步从句,主语在村里被养大(be raised,被动)→ raised。

questions.stem: "____ a chance to record, the unemployed man finally shared his song with the world."
questions.explanation: 表条件 = If/Once he was offered…,主语被给予机会(被动)→ Offered。

questions.stem: "Even though ____ by his own teachers, the boy never gave up the piano."
questions.explanation: 让步从句,主语被老师们打击(被动)→ discouraged。

questions.stem: "____ for singing performances, the Silver Hall is always full of energy."
questions.explanation: 主句主语 the hall 被用于演出(被动)→ 过去分词 Used;若用 Using 则错(大厅不会主动'使用')。

questions.stem: "____ their own videos at home, the choir members later joined them into one."
questions.explanation: 主句主语 the members 主动录制(主动)→ 现在分词 Recording;此处主语发出动作,不能用 Recorded。

questions.stem: "____ in 12 different countries, the singers were joined into one online video."
questions.explanation: 主句主语 the singers 被拍摄(被动)→ 过去分词 Filmed。

questions.stem: "____ his fans to send videos, Whitacre created his first virtual choir."
questions.explanation: 主句主语 Whitacre 主动请求(主动)→ 现在分词 Asking;主语发出动作,不能用 Asked。

questions.stem: "____ by millions online, his first virtual choir became world-famous."
questions.explanation: 主句主语 the choir 被观看(被动)→ 过去分词 Viewed。

questions.stem: "____ Mozart's classical music, the student felt his whole world light up."
questions.explanation: 主句主语 the student 主动听(主动)→ 现在分词 Hearing;主语发出动作,不能用 Heard。

questions.stem: "____ in a quiet studio, the new song sounded warm and clear."
questions.explanation: 主句主语 the song 被制作(被动)→ 过去分词 Produced。

questions.stem: "____ the violin on the street, the boy soon drew a large crowd."
questions.explanation: 主句主语 the boy 主动拉琴(主动)→ 现在分词 Playing;主语发出动作,不能用 Played。

questions.stem: "____ with great care, the old album still plays without a single problem."
questions.explanation: 主句主语 the album 被保管(被动)→ 过去分词 Kept。

questions.stem: "____ together every weekend, the band slowly built a loyal following."
questions.explanation: 主句主语 the band 主动排练(主动)→ 现在分词 Practising;主语发出动作,不能用 Practised。

questions.stem: "____ by a famous composer, the song quickly spread around the world."
questions.explanation: 主句主语 the song 被创作(被动)→ 过去分词 Written。

questions.stem: "____ the audience with her voice, the singer forgot all her nerves."
questions.explanation: 主句主语 the singer 主动打动观众(主动)→ 现在分词 Touching;主语发出动作,不能用 Touched。

questions.stem: "____ in dark colours, the concert hall needed much brighter lights."
questions.explanation: 主句主语 the hall 被刷漆(被动)→ 过去分词 Painted。

questions.stem: "____ a happy song to the patients, the doctor helped them relax."
questions.explanation: 主句主语 the doctor 主动放歌(主动)→ 现在分词 Playing;主语发出动作,不能用 Played。

questions.stem: "____ thousands of times online, the simple folk song became a hit."
questions.explanation: 主句主语 the song 被分享(被动)→ 过去分词 Shared。

questions.stem: "____ her own piano piece, the nervous girl gradually calmed down."
questions.explanation: 主句主语 the girl 主动演奏(主动)→ 现在分词 Performing;主语发出动作,不能用 Performed。

questions.stem: "____ for years in a small band, the guitar still sounds wonderful."
questions.explanation: 主句主语 the guitar 被使用(被动)→ 过去分词 Used。

questions.stem: "____ the crowd to clap along, the street performer smiled brightly."
questions.explanation: 主句主语 the performer 主动邀请(主动)→ 现在分词 Inviting;主语发出动作,不能用 Invited。

questions.stem: "____ in 1827, Beethoven's music is still loved all over the world."
questions.explanation: 主句主语 the music 被创作(被动)→ 过去分词 Composed。
